items.title: 13.5 Kinetic theory aur statistical physics (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.5, kinetic theory and statistical physics (PDF 11-12); the energy-level figure is ours (Roman Urdu only).

blocks.text: Ab tak humne dekha ke kinetic theory of gases, molecules ki thermal (random) motion maan kar, gas laws ki madad se ideal gas ka pressure nikalti hai. Jab molecules bohat zyada hon to hum statistical physics istemal karte hain. Yeh physics ki woh branch (shakh) hai jo probability (kisi baat ke hone ka chance) ki theory se kaam leti hai. Is ke mutabiq system ke atoms aur molecules alag alag speeds ki wajah se alag alag energy states (levels) E₁, E₂, E₃ waghaira mein ho sakte hain.

blocks.title: Aap ki maloomat ke liye
blocks.text: 1860 mein James Clerk Maxwell (1831–1879) ne ek formula nikala jo thermal equilibrium (garmi ke lehaz se balance) wale system mein molecules ki speeds ki distribution (kis speed par kitne molecules) batata hai. Taqreeban 60 saal baad experiments ne Maxwell ki predictions (pehle se batayi gayi baaton) ko confirm (sahi sabit) kiya.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab naam 'James Clark Maxwell' chhapti hai; sahi naam James Clerk Maxwell hai.

Boltzmann ne Boltzmann kinetic equation nikali. Yeh bohat se molecules wali gases mein hone wale dynamic processes (badalte rehne wale amal) ko bayan karti hai. Boltzmann constant do levels mein atoms ki population (ginti) se bhi juda hai:

N₁ neeche (kam energy) wale state ki aur N₂ oopar (zyada energy) wale state ki population hai, aur ΔE = E₂ – E₁ dono states ki energy ka difference (farq) hai. Kitab yeh bhi kehti hai ke number density (unit volume mein particles) pressure ke directly proportional hai (P = N₀k_BT se, jab temperature same ho). Is equation ko Boltzmann distribution law kehte hain; yeh bohat se molecules ki statistical mechanics mein basic (buniyadi) law hai. Is ke mutabiq kisi energy state mein molecule milne ka chance, energy ÷ k_BT barhne ke saath exponentially (bohat tezi se) kam hota hai. Is liye neeche ke energy states mein oopar walon se zyada particles hote hain.

blocks.alt: Do boxes, har ek mein paanch barabar faasle wale energy levels E1 se E5. Kam temperature par 25 particles: E1 par 16, E2 par 6, E3 par 2, E4 par 1, E5 par 0. Zyada temperature par wahi 25 particles: E1 par 10, E2 par 6, E3 par 4, E4 par 3, E5 par 2.
blocks.caption: Energy levels mein particles ki Boltzmann distribution (hamari original drawing; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono boxes mein particles barabar, 25 hain: garam karne se particles barhte nahi, sirf oopar ke levels mein phail jate hain. Kam temperature par zyada tar particles sab se neeche E₁ par hain aur E₅ khali hai. Zyada temperature par k_BT bara hai, is liye Boltzmann factor e^(−ΔE/k_BT) bara hota hai aur oopar ke levels ki population barhti hai, lekin har oopar wala level phir bhi neeche wale se kam bhara hai.

Gas ke container mein ek molecule har second billions (arbon) takkarein karta hai. Har takkar us ki speed aur kinetic energy badal deti hai, lekin kinetic theory ka result (nateeja) hai ke temperature T par average kinetic energy:
Yahan k_B asal mein 'ek molecule ke liye gas constant' hai (R ek mole ke liye, k_B = R/N_A ek molecule ke liye).

blocks.prompt: Do levels ka energy difference ΔE = k_BT hai. Neeche wale level ke muqable mein oopar wale level mein kitne particles hain?
blocks.explanation: N₂/N₁ = e^(−ΔE/k_BT) = e⁻¹ ≈ 0.37. Yani oopar wale level mein neeche wale ke taqreeban 37% particles hain.

items: Bohat se particles ke liye statistical physics (probability) istemal hoti hai.
Boltzmann distribution law: N₂/N₁ = e^(−ΔE/k_BT); neeche ke levels mein zyada particles.
E_av = (3/2)k_BT; k_B ek molecule ke liye gas constant hai.
